### Added

- (gs) [Show the backends of HTTPRoutes on the Gateways tab](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3509) by [@weatherhog](https://github.com/weatherhog) — On a cluster's Gateways tab, the HTTPRoutes table has a `Backends` column naming the services each route sends traffic to, with a notice where the cluster's Gateway API bundle is too old to report them. Long listener and policy names wrap instead of being cut off.

### Fixed

- (auth) [Recognize gazelle federation staff identities](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3633) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — Giant Swarm staff who sign in through the new federated sign-in connector are signed in as their catalog user instead of an identity outside the catalog, as their profile and Settings pages show.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.46.0...v3.47.0
